channel.title: Shoaib Hussan – Blog
channel.description: Guides on shop drawings, CAD and 3D.

item.title: Marble Shop Drawings: A Complete Guide for Fabricators and Contractors
item.description: What marble and stone shop drawings must include, how they are approved, and how to avoid costly fabrication errors on site.

item.title: Quantity Take-Off vs Bill of Quantities: What Is the Difference?
item.description: Quantity take-off and bill of quantities explained in plain English: what each one is, how a take-off is measured, how a BOQ is structured and which one your project needs.

item.title: How to Calculate Marble Quantity in Square Feet, Square Metres and Slabs
item.description: A practical method to calculate marble and stone quantities: measure net area, convert square feet and square metres, allow for waste and book-matching, and estimate how many slabs to order.

item.title: Shop Drawings vs Construction Drawings: Key Differences Explained
item.description: How shop drawings differ from construction drawings, design drawings, fabrication drawings and submittals, who prepares each, and why the difference matters on site.

item.title: Outsourcing AutoCAD Drafting Services: What to Expect and How to Prepare
item.description: A practical checklist for architects, contractors and homeowners hiring a freelance AutoCAD drafter, from inputs and file formats to revisions.

item.title: Construction Cost Estimate Classes and Accuracy Levels Explained
item.description: What the five construction cost estimate classes mean, how accurate each one is, what information each needs and how quantity take-offs move an estimate from a rough budget to a firm price.

item.title: How to Prepare Your Project for 3D Rendering Services
item.description: The drawings, materials and references a 3D visualiser needs to produce realistic architectural and interior renders on the first attempt.

item.title: Shop Drawings in Dubai: Understanding the Submission and Approval Process
item.description: How shop drawings are prepared, submitted and approved on Dubai and UAE projects, with tips for subcontractors on fit-out, joinery and stone packages.

item.title: What Is BIM? A Plain-English Guide for Small Firms and Contractors
item.description: An honest introduction to Building Information Modelling for small practices and contractors, including levels of detail, benefits and when 2D CAD is still enough.

item.title: Website Checklist for Contractors and Stone Companies
item.description: A practical checklist for building a fast, trustworthy, search-friendly website for construction, fit-out and marble businesses in the USA, UK, Canada and UAE.
